request.style: English, male gravelly voice, solo vocal, acoustic guitar, upright bass, piano, brushed drums, somber but hopeful, 80 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
How long must I carry worries within me
With grief in my heart all the day
Look at me and answer, LORD my God
Give light to my eyes before I fade

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD today
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Verse]
My enemy may say he has overcome me
My foes may rejoice when I fall
But I will not hide my face in fear
I know your presence is the wall

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD today
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Bridge]
No more shall the shadow keep its hold
The night is breaking on the hill
Your hand is the only one that stays
When all the world is silent still

[Chorus]
But I trust in your steadfast love
My heart rejoices in your salvation
I will sing to the LORD today
For he has dealt bountifully with me

[Outro]
I will sing to the LORD
For he has dealt bountifully with me
